name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Security & Privacy Controls Compliance
description: Compliance framework for NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations, covering 20 control families (AC, AU, CM, IA, IR, RA, SC, SI, etc.), RMF Step 4 authorization, and continuous control monitoring.
owner: NIST RMF Governance & Enterprise Architecture Office

checklists.name: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Control Family Verification Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 control families across AC, AU, CM, IA, IR, SC, and SI.

items.statement: Access Control policies enforce Principle of Least Privilege (AC-6) and separation of duties (AC-5).
Audit events are logged centrally into a SIEM with timestamp synchronization (NTP) and integrity protection (AU-2, AU-8, AU-9).
Configuration baselines are enforced and unauthorized software installation is blocked (CM-2, CM-7).
Flaw remediation (SI-2) deploys critical security patches within 30 days of vendor release.
System boundary protection devices (firewalls, WAFs) isolate internal subnetworks from external networks (SC-7).

reviewGates.name: NIST RMF Authorizing Official (AO) Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Authorizing Official (AO) and Chief Information Security Officer confirm that security control assessment results warrant formal System Authorization (ATO).
reviewGates.prompt: Does the Security Assessment Report (SAR) demonstrate acceptable risk to grant an ATO under NIST RMF?
